name: document_categorizer_agent
label: Document Categorizer
description: Parses documents (Text, PDF, Word DOCX), generates an N-word summary, extracts keywords/tags, and classifies into target document categories.

user_properties.label: Summary Target (Words)
user_properties.description: Approximate number of words for document summary.

user_properties.label: Max Keywords/Tags
user_properties.description: Maximum number of keywords/tags to extract.

user_properties.label: Target Categories
user_properties.default: Invoice, Resume, Contract, Policy, Report, Technical, General
user_properties.description: Comma-separated list of allowed document categories.

user_properties.label: LLM Profile
user_properties.description: Select LLM Profile preset for endpoint, model, and authentication settings.

user_properties.label: Model Type
user_properties.description: Matching section in LLM profile (e.g. generation, embedding, reranking).

user_properties.label: Input Document(s)
user_properties.description: Select one or more documents to process. Accepted: PDF, Word (.docx/.doc), plain text. The server reads these paths at execution time.

text.description: Plain text content or document text
